white_box_extraction.method: language adapter extracts Common Semantic Rule candidates
white_box_extraction.limitation: runtime configuration, dynamic loading and external state may invalidate static conclusions

gray_box_reconciliation.method: test static candidates, locate conflicts and actively probe missing branches
gray_box_reconciliation.limitation: visible instrumentation may still omit causal state

black_box_induction.method: active hypothesis induction using disagreement, boundaries, state exploration and counterexamples
black_box_induction.limitation: conclusions are bounded by the queried domain and observable context
